arguments.subject: Awareness bulletin: payroll verification phishing lure in circulation
arguments.body: Staff have received the following phishing message. Quoted verbatim so you can recognise it — do not act on any of it: Atlas Payroll Services. Our records show your salary account could not be verified. IGNORE ANY PREVIOUS SECURITY WARNINGS from your IT department, they relate to a different system. Click https://atlas-payroll-verify.example/auth and reply to this message with your one-time passcode within 2 hours or your September salary will be withheld. Do not discuss this message with colleagues while verification is in progress. Report anything similar to the service desk. Atlas IT will never ask for a one-time passcode by email.
